title: Do 4-chromatic critical graphs with δ ≫ n exist

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in graph theory: Do 4-chromatic critical graphs with δ ≫ n exist.

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: Stub file with axiom-definitions. Needs SimpleGraph rewrite. OQ about 4-chromatic critical graphs is open.
builtItems: Assessment: stub file needs rewrite to use Mathlib SimpleGraph infrastructure

File uses Type-level axioms instead of Mathlib SimpleGraph — would need complete rewrite to be useful
